rationale: Record Pulp-owned recovery of authored CSS gradient geometry, layered background placement and repetition, knob and fader indicators, and the corresponding DesignIR, generated-runtime, native-materializer, and bridge persistence needed for Forge panels to retain Chromium fidelity in Skia. Unsupported painted round and space repeat modes now fail closed into browser-native capture instead of silently disappearing. The work restores existing Pulp import and rendering behavior without changing Vellum source authority, the accepted expansion boundary, or design-import ownership.
tests: Forge Dilla Chromium-to-Skia exact replay at 98 percent registered fidelity
